galaxy10_morphology.task: Galaxy Zoo 10 / Galaxy10 DECaLS 10-way morphology classification

competitors.name: AION-1-B
competitors.head: 2-layer MLP on frozen embeddings
competitors.eval_dataset: Galaxy Zoo 10 cross-matched with Legacy Survey DR10

competitors.name: AION-1-L
competitors.head: 2-layer MLP on frozen embeddings
competitors.eval_dataset: Galaxy Zoo 10 cross-matched with Legacy Survey DR10

competitors.name: AION-1-XL
competitors.head: 2-layer MLP on frozen embeddings
competitors.eval_dataset: Galaxy Zoo 10 cross-matched with Legacy Survey DR10

galaxy10_morphology.caveats: AION evaluates on a Galaxy Zoo 10 / Legacy Survey DR10 cross-match (~8k galaxies), not the Galaxy10 DECaLS HDF5. Our linear-probe rows additionally differ in head capacity; the galaxy10_matched_heads rows reproduce AION's 2-layer MLP head (and AstroCLIP's 4-layer MLP) exactly, leaving only the dataset difference.

gzd5_morphology.caveats: Same question set and debiased-label protocol as our gzd5_morphology_probe, so this is the closest to a like-for-like comparison we have.

redshift_regression.caveats: Our probe regresses Galaxy10 DECaLS metadata redshifts (z mostly < 0.25) from images alone; AstroCLIP and AION use different cross-matched samples and, for AION, photometry inputs. The AstroCLIP image rows are the closest protocol match (image-only, kNN and MLP heads).
